episodes.title: Olivia
episodes.summary: After solving a case in Japan, private eye John Sugar returns to LA to help find a missing woman with ties to a Hollywood legend.

episodes.title: These People, These Places
episodes.summary: Sugar suspects Melanie's not telling the full story. Meanwhile, he and Ruby may not be the only ones looking into the mysterious body in Olivia's trunk.

episodes.title: Shibuya Crossing
episodes.summary: Melanie and Sugar get caught in a dicey situation—and make a new enemy. Sugar reunites with old friends, but he senses some are keeping secrets.

episodes.title: Starry-Eyed
episodes.summary: Sugar and Melanie track down Olivia's friend, who shares disturbing information about Davy and his family. Davy and Kenny dig into Sugar's past.

episodes.title: Boy in the Corner
episodes.summary: Melanie gets a surprise visit that unleashes Sugar's dark side. Ruby receives chilling guidance from a colleague. Davy makes a tragic decision.

episodes.title: Go Home
episodes.summary: Sugar thinks he's made a break in the case. When a double cross forces him to do the unthinkable, he turns to Melanie and Henry for help.

episodes.title: The Friends You Keep
episodes.summary: Sugar's fears for the safety of his friends lead him to a clandestine gathering where he learns a dangerous secret—and the truth about Olivia.

episodes.title: Farewell
episodes.summary: Season finale. A shocking realization points Sugar toward a discovery that changes everything.

episodes.title: Home Away from Home
episodes.summary: Sugar takes on a new case: Tracking down the troubled brother of rising local boxer Danny Moon.

episodes.title: Downer Town
episodes.summary: The search for Ji sends Sugar into dangerous territory. Danny resorts to desperate measures.

episodes.title: Watch Face
episodes.summary: Danny gets a lead on Ji. Back at the Del, Sugar finds himself with a new admirer.

episodes.title: Off 15
episodes.summary: Sugar makes a powerful enemy and has a falling out with Charlotte. The race to find Ji is on.

episodes.title: Unknowns
episodes.summary: Vega isn't convinced his problem with Ji is solved. Sugar befriends someone in Pavich's inner circle.

episodes.title: Cautionary Tale
episodes.summary: Sugar wrestles with his fear of contamination. Vega forces Sugar to make an impossible choice.

episodes.title: What Else Can You Do?
episodes.summary: With every other option spent, Sugar plays one last card. Charlotte opens up to Sugar.

episodes.title: Like Sugar
episodes.summary: Season finale. Sugar attends an event that shakes him to his core.
